run_streamlit_demo: run the streamlit demo script that displays a cached hiplot experiment with sliders
create_cached_experiment: create a cached hiplot experiment with 1000 rows using the st.cache decorator
compress_experiment: set the experimental _compress flag on a hiplot experiment to reduce bandwidth at first load
convert_to_streamlit: convert a hiplot experiment to a Streamlit-compatible object using the to_streamlit method
display_experiment: display a cached hiplot experiment in the Streamlit app using the display method
